text: Sildenafil acts as a potent and selective competitive inhibitor of the cGMP-specific phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5A) enzyme. By blocking the catalytic site of PDE5A, sildenafil prevents the degradation of cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP) in the corpus cavernosum, thereby sustaining the smooth muscle relaxation and vasodilation required for an erection.
